items.title: Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there
items.description: Some of the most dramatic footage from the deadly flash flooding is hidden from public view in China.

items.title: At least 27 dead and hundreds evacuated after strikes near Kyiv
items.description: A 14-year-old girl is among the dead after an attack near the capital overnight, the region's governor said.

items.title: Trump hails 'historic' deal for US to control 65bn barrels of Venezuela's oil
items.description: Venezuelan interim president says the unusual agreement will help revive her country's economy.

items.title: Landlady to 9/11 hijackers reveals their links to alleged Saudi spy
items.description: A woman who rented out homes to two al-Qaeda members speaks publicly for the first time - to the BBC.

items.title: Norway mourns King Harald as Haakon VIII ascends throne
items.description: Mourners gather outside the palace as royals, politicians and citizens remember a beloved king, whose son has adopted the family motto "all for norway".

items.title: Right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos detained by ICE
items.description: The British citizen, who lives and works in the US, has supported Trump and ICE agents in the past.

items.title: Close race as Iceland votes on whether to restart talks on joining EU
items.description: Turbulent international affairs have brought the vote forward, but the campaign has focused more on Iceland's vital fishing industry.

items.title: Ex-White House teleprompter operator ordered to pay $172,000 for Trump speech bets
items.description: The staffer was found to have used his prior knowledge of the president's speeches to place lucrative bets.

items.title: Dutch institute issues 'red alert' over Trump-shaped ecstasy pills
items.description: The drugs have a delayed effect which "increases the risk of overdose", the institute has advised.

items.title: Oslo mayor calls off wedding ceremony after death of Norway's king
items.description: Anne Lindboe, the mayor of Norway's capital, had planned to marry her fiance on Friday.

items.title: Russia ramps up rhetoric but wants to avoid war with Nato, Western officials say
items.description: But they say Moscow will likely continue its "hybrid activity" against Nato members, short of direct military action.

items.title: Canada poaches dozens of top US researchers for its universities
items.description: Researchers in fields like climate and medicine are being lured north by new research funding.

items.title: Berlin is being blackmailed by hackers, mayor says
items.description: Kai Wegner says the German capital and city-state would not cave in to a ransom demand for data stolen in a cyber-attack.

items.title: Thieves steal 600-diamond necklace from Vienna museum in broad daylight
items.description: Police are hunting two suspects they believe bought a ticket for the exhibition to get at the jewellery.

items.title: Greenland says findings on genocide allegation not final
items.description: Experts examined the use of forced contraception on the Inuit community during the 1960s and 70s.

items.title: Violence breaks out in Ceuta as migrant crisis continues
items.description: A group of migrants is accused of throwing stones at a military vehicle, while some locals set fire to their camps on the beach.

items.title: World's youngest reigning traditional monarch dies aged 34
items.description: King Oyo ascended to the throne of Uganda's Tooro kingdom when he was just three years old.

items.title: US plans to cut off military aid to key Middle East ally, BBC told
items.description: Iraqi Kurdistan fears the Trump administration's plan will make the region more vulnerable to further attacks from Iran.

items.title: Two-year curfew lifted in Sudan's capital
items.description: The military authorities retook control of the city 18 months ago, but the conflict continues elsewhere.

items.title: Shootings surge as drug gangs torment Brussels
items.description: This year alone there have been more than 65 shootings in the Belgian capital, as drug crime soars.
